newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ISRAEL, April 29 - Haifa - Three vessels due, 2-3 days delay. Discharging at berth, 7 general, 2 bulk. Loading/discharging, 4 containers, 2 tankers. Waiting to discharge, 3 general cargo, 3 bulk. 1 Container vessel loading/discharging at anchorage, 1 vessel under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to three days delay. 1 Bulker loading at berth. Discharging, 7 general cargo, 2 bulk. Loading/discharging, 2 containers, 1 tanker, 1 passenger. 1 General cargo waiting to discharge, 1 container waiting to load/discharge, 2 vessels awaiting orders. Eilat - One due. 1 tanker and 1 passenger loading/discharging at berth.
JORDAN, April 26 - Aqaba - One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 awaiting orders.

NIGERIA, April 29 - Bonny - Strike by local staff of Shell sub-contractors over, vessel loading programme resumed. Lagos - No berthing delays. Port Harcourt - No berthing delays. Warri - Terminal operating and pipeline to Kaduna refinery normal. River port of Koko temporarily closed due to disturbances. Odudu - Minor technical difficulties delaying current loading by approx. 2 days. All other crude terminals reported as operating normally.

TUNISIA, April 26 - Sousse - Seven vessels in port of which 1 discharging marble chips, 2 discharging general cargo, 3 discharging woodpulp, 1 loading bulk salt. No waiting time, no vessels awaiting orders. April 28 - Bizerta - Five vessels in port of which 1 each discharging timber, coke. 2 Loading steel, 1 loading clinker, no delays. Zarzis - No berthing delays.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, April 27 - Dubai - Containers, 37 vessels due, 5 loading at berth. General cargo, 11 vessels due, 7 loading at berth. 1 Vessel under repair/laid up. Tankers, 12 vessels due, 5 under repair.

YEMEN, April 28 - Hodeidah - Berths 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 occupied. 5 Vessels alongside of which 2 flour, 2 rice, 1 steel. 1 Flour vessel anchored. Berthing delays, general cargo/containers up to 1 day, bagged cargo up to 2 days, bulk cargo up to 6 days. Mokha - No vessels.
